meta.title: Networks Ledger
meta.phase: Phase 1 — US + US-allied Gulf; high-confidence public official actions
meta.disclaimer: Independent aggregation of public official announcements only (US Treasury/OFAC, DOJ, State, UAE Cabinet/TFTC). Charges and designations are allegations until adjudicated. Not affiliated with any government.
meta.scope: Networks: IRGC, Hezbollah, Muslim Brotherhood, Hamas-linked financing, Mixed/Axis. Geography: United States and US-allied Gulf (UAE, TFTC partners). Phase 2+ will expand Europe/Africa and Lebanon capital-flight cases.

entries.title: OFAC designates Egyptian and Jordanian Muslim Brotherhood branches as SDGTs
entries.summary: Treasury OFAC designated the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood and Jordanian Muslim Brotherhood as Specially Designated Global Terrorists under E.O. 13224 (as amended) for material support to Hamas. Concurrent State action covered the Lebanese chapter (separate entry).

entries.title: State designates Lebanese Muslim Brotherhood as FTO and SDGT
entries.summary: Department of State designated the Lebanese Muslim Brotherhood (al-Jamaa al-Islamiyah) as a Foreign Terrorist Organization and SDGT, and designated Secretary General Muhammad Fawzi Taqqosh as an SDGT, concurrent with Treasury designations of Egyptian and Jordanian MB branches.

entries.amountNote: Blocking of property and interests in property of designated persons subject to US jurisdiction (amount not quantified in announcement).
entries.title: OFAC SDN list update — MB branches blocked under CT authorities
entries.summary: OFAC published SDN List updates adding Egyptian, Jordanian, and related Muslim Brotherhood listings under SDGT (and FTO for the Lebanese chapter via State), implementing asset blocking for US persons and US jurisdiction property.

entries.title: Terrorist designation of the Sudanese Muslim Brotherhood
entries.summary: OFAC Recent Actions record a terrorist designation related to the Sudanese Muslim Brotherhood (counterterrorism designations; Sudan-related designation update), continuing the 2026 MB chapter designation campaign.

entities: Hayat Yolu (Türkiye-based, referenced as MB financial hub)
entries.title: OFAC designates sham charities funding Hamas military wing
entries.summary: Treasury announced designations of four sham charities that directly fund Hamas’s military wing (Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades). Announcement also referenced Türkiye-based Hayat Yolu as an operational headquarters and banking/financial hub for Muslim Brotherhood-related activity.

entries.title: UAE State Security dismantles Hezbollah/Iran-funded terror network
entries.summary: UAE State Security Apparatus announced the dismantling of a terrorist network funded and operated by Hezbollah and Iran, with members arrested. Authorities said the network operated under fictitious commercial cover and sought to infiltrate the national economy.

source.label: WAM / official UAE State Security announcement (via WAM English)

entries.amountNote: Treasury stated the network enabled diversion of over $100 million since 2020 (estimate in official release).
entries.title: OFAC sanctions Alaa Hamieh global network diverting funds to Hezbollah
entries.summary: OFAC designated a network of 16 individuals and entities led by Hezbollah financier and former Lebanese public investment official Alaa Hassan Hamieh. Treasury said companies in Lebanon, Syria, Poland, Slovenia, Qatar, and Canada launder and raise funds for Hezbollah’s finance team.

entities: 5 Lebanon-based entities incl. al-Qard al-Hassan (per official reporting)
entries.title: UAE Local Terrorist List: 16 individuals + 5 entities over Hezbollah links
entries.summary: UAE Cabinet Resolution No. (63) of 2026 added 16 Lebanese nationals and five Lebanon-based entities to the UAE Local Terrorist List over links to Hezbollah, as reported by WAM. Entities reported include al-Qard al-Hassan and related companies.

source.label: WAM / Gulf News official cabinet reporting

entries.title: SDNY charges Iraqi operative with material support to IRGC and Kata’ib Hizballah
entries.summary: US Attorney SDNY announced arrest and charges against Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood Al-Saadi, alleged senior Kata’ib Hizballah member, for material support to Kata’ib Hizballah and the IRGC and related terrorism offenses. Charges are allegations until adjudicated.

location.label: Washington, DC (ops: Lebanon, Syria, Iraq, Oman)

entries.amountNote: Release cites nearly $10 million in fees on certain Syria-related equipment contracts linked to the network (not a total freeze amount).
entries.title: OFAC expands Alaa Hamieh designations + Hezbollah-aligned officials
entries.summary: OFAC designated additional Hezbollah-aligned Lebanese officials and expanded the March 2026 Alaa Hamieh network action, targeting interlocutors in Lebanon, Syria, Iraq, and Oman alleged to raise funds and operate front companies for Hezbollah revenue.

entries.title: TFTC joint designations: Hezbollah financial institutions and senior officials
entries.summary: Terrorist Financing Targeting Center (US and Gulf members, co-chaired by the United States and Saudi Arabia) announced joint designations targeting key Hezbollah financial infrastructure, including Al-Qard Al-Hassan and Bayt al-Mal and senior leaders (five entities and 16 individuals).

entries.title: TFTC Round 9 designation record — Lebanese Hezbollah financial entities
entries.summary: TFTC public designations index records Round 9 (June 30, 2026): coordinated designation of Lebanese Hezbollah financial entities by TFTC member states.

entries.title: OFAC designates Mahmoud al-Abyari + Hamas/MB financial facilitators
entries.summary: OFAC designated UK-based senior Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood official Mahmoud al-Abyari (Secretary General of the MB General Secretariat) for acting on behalf of the Egyptian MB, plus three individuals and three entities providing material support to Hamas. Release cites support for previously sanctioned Filistin Vakfi and Hayat Yolu and MB-linked fundraising for Hamas.

entries.title: Treasury sanctions Hezbollah financial officials tied to Al-Qard Al-Hassan
entries.summary: OFAC sanctioned Hezbollah financial officials who served in senior management roles for Al-Qard Al-Hassan (AQAH), a Hezbollah-linked financial institution previously designated in 2007. Builds the public record for later TFTC joint AQAH targeting.

entries.amountNote: Trial evidence cited nearly $100,000,000 moved by co-conspirators in less than 18 months (not all attributed solely to listed networks).
entries.title: EDVA jury convicts Lebanese-Syrian national in narco-terrorism / material support case
entries.summary: Federal jury in EDVA convicted dual Lebanese-Syrian national Antoine Kassis on narco-terrorism conspiracy and conspiracy to provide material support to a designated FTO. Court records cited large-scale money movement involving organizations including Hamas among others. Conviction is a court outcome; read full DOJ release for charges and evidence summary.

entries.title: DOJ: Turkey-based sham charity director charged with material support to Hamas
entries.summary: DOJ Office of Public Affairs announced arrest and charging of Mohammad Yousef Hasna, described as Turkey-based global director of a sham charity, with conspiring to provide material support to Hamas. Charges are allegations until adjudicated.

source.label: DOJ OPA — Turkey-based sham charity director (Hasna)

entities: Individuals subject to secondary sanctions under Hizballah Financial Sanctions Regulations
entries.title: OFAC adds secondary sanctions information (Hizballah FSR)
entries.summary: OFAC Recent Actions updated SDN listings with secondary sanctions information pursuant to the Hizballah Financial Sanctions Regulations, expanding compliance exposure for non-US persons dealing with listed Hezbollah-linked actors.

entries.title: US policy package: first-step MB chapter terrorist designations
entries.summary: State and Treasury coordinated first-step designations against Egyptian, Jordanian, and Lebanese Muslim Brotherhood chapters under the Administration’s MB-focused counterterrorism policy (E.O. 14362 context as described in State release).

entries.title: Geographic pin: Hezbollah financial institutions headquartered in Lebanon
entries.summary: Map pin for Lebanon-based Hezbollah financial institutions (AQAH, Bayt al-Mal) targeted in the June 30, 2026 TFTC/US joint action. Source is the Treasury TFTC release describing the entities as major Hezbollah financial infrastructure.

entries.title: Geographic pin: Türkiye-based Hayat Yolu cited as MB financial hub
entries.summary: Treasury’s March 12, 2026 Hamas sham-charity action identified Türkiye-based Hayat Yolu as an operational headquarters and banking/financial hub for Muslim Brotherhood-related activity. Pin is for map context of that official description.

entries.title: Geographic pin: UK-based EMB senior official Mahmoud al-Abyari
entries.summary: Treasury described Mahmoud al-Abyari as a United Kingdom-based senior leader of the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood designated July 23, 2026. Pin marks the publicly stated base location; designation authority is US OFAC.

entries.title: Geographic pin: TFTC co-chair Saudi Arabia in Hezbollah finance action
entries.summary: TFTC is co-chaired by the United States and Saudi Arabia with GCC members. This pin marks the Gulf co-chair side of the June 30, 2026 joint Hezbollah financial designations.

entries.title: Geographic pin: Bahrain as TFTC member in joint Hezbollah action
entries.summary: Bahrain is a TFTC member state. Pin supports Phase-1 Gulf geography for the June 30, 2026 joint designations of Hezbollah financial infrastructure.

entities: UAE Local Terrorist List — Hezbollah-linked package
entries.title: Geographic pin: UAE commercial jurisdiction for Local Terrorist List action
entries.summary: Secondary UAE map pin for the May 2026 Cabinet Local Terrorist List action against Hezbollah-linked individuals and entities (primary announcement in Abu Dhabi).

entries.amountNote: Official estimate of funds diverted since 2020 by the designated network — not a single seized bank balance figure.
entries.title: Asset-blocking implications of Alaa Hamieh network SDGT package
entries.summary: Companion ledger row emphasizing the asset-blocking effect of the March 20, 2026 OFAC package: US persons blocked from transactions with designated parties; Treasury quantified over $100 million diverted since 2020 via the network’s schemes.

entries.title: SDNY ongoing Hamas material-support enforcement posture
entries.summary: Placeholder chronology anchor: SDNY has unsealed multiple Hamas material-support matters (including leadership complaints) that frame later 2025–2026 financing cases. Prefer specific defendant PR rows for case-level detail. Allegations until adjudicated.

entities: Egyptian MB — material support rationale to Hamas
entries.title: Designation rationale: Egyptian/Jordanian MB material support to Hamas
entries.summary: Treasury stated Egyptian and Jordanian MB branches were designated for having materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, or technological support for Hamas under E.O. 13224 as amended — establishing the legal nexus used in later al-Abyari and sham-charity actions.
